source.source_revision: Wahapedia Space Marines App 2.8.1 / October 2026; stable Last_update 2026-10-19 03:47:32; live page checked 2026-10-28.
source.chapter_context: Shared-book Space Marines profile. The Ravenwing Black Knights Dark Angels Chapter-book Leader target is now integrated separately; Chapter roster restrictions remain uncertified.
source.game_mode: Standard Warhammer 40,000 11th edition through the local match/action runtime; this is not full-match certification.

fixed_data_comparison.limit: Per-profile fixed-data parity only. The broader comparator parent source is structurally invalid and this profile result does not certify complete behavior or other datasheets.

profile.base_geometry: oval; runtime collision geometry uses a 90 x 52 mm bounding-circle proxy
options: Heavy Bolt Pistol may be replaced with Plasma Pistol (standard and supercharge profiles).
Master-crafted Power Weapon may be replaced with Thunder Hammer.
legal_loadout_packages_checked: Heavy Bolt Pistol + Master-crafted Power Weapon
profile.source_listed_chapter_book_target: Ravenwing Black Knights (Dark Angels Chapter book; now integrated under its separate profile)

scope: Exact one-model profile, source characteristics, 110-point cost, keywords, oval-base dimensions and explicit runtime geometry limitation.
Default weapons and both independent replacement choices; all four legal packages and every weapon profile, including both Plasma Pistol modes, pass Equipment and AttackPlan.
Current consolidated Space Marines catalogs materialize the profile for both players; the catalog accepts one to three copies and rejects a fourth.
This Captain suite exercises the shared-book Outrider Squad target; the separate Dark Angels Ravenwing Black Knights link is exercised by its own sheet scope suite.
Combat Doctrines, Leader, Strategic Acumen, Transhuman Strategist and Into the Fray are present in the source ability map.
Public Warlord choice and once-per-round Transhuman Strategist CP are checked.
Strategic Acumen is owner-checked, selectable in the owner's Command phase, limited to once that phase, persists through the opponent's Command phase and expires at the next own Command phase.
Into the Fray grants Cleave 1 to melee attacks after a charge move and not without a charge move.

verification.command: python tools/verify.py --godot 'C:\Godot\4.7.2\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe' --profile focused --only test_ravenwing_black_knights --only test_captain_on_bike --only test_outrider_squad_current --timeout 300

limits: Closes only the Captain on Bike shared-book local datasheet scope; fixed-data parity is profile-specific, not a behavior certificate.
Runtime base collision uses a bounding-circle proxy; exact oval placement geometry remains open.
Ravenwing Black Knights remains outside the Captain's common-book scope but is now independently integrated; Chapter roster restrictions are not certified.
Full faction/army legality, network behavior, complete-match certification and human playtesting remain outside this closure; network validation is deferred to final integration.
